Access.name: isFondoCollocabile
Access.Query: select (trunc(nvl(dat_fine_sscr_aggiu,sysdate)) - trunc(sysdate)) from cat_prod.DETT_OPERT_PROD where cod_prod_contnre = ? AND cod_tipo_sist_orig_disp = ? AND COD_ISIN = ? and gstd_f_esist='S' and dat_iniz_colloc_bmed < trunc(sysdate) and nvl(dat_fine_colloc_bmed, to_date('99991231', 'YYYYMMDD')) > trunc(sysdate)
